_note: Manual review (2026-09-06) of reported bugs that did not match an upstream leak-fix commit. Keyed by file:function, shared by all runs. verdict TP = genuine leak, still present at upstream HEAD (FETCH_HEAD, Sep 2026); FP = not a leak; TP-FIXED = genuine leak in 9.2.0015 that a later commit without 'leak' in its subject removed.

src/clipboard.c:clip_wl_init_buffer_stor.note: In 9.2.0015: store = alloc(); ftruncate() failure returned NULL without vim_free(store). The wl_shm buffer-store code (mch_create_anon_file/ftruncate/wl_shm_create_pool) no longer exists at upstream HEAD, so the leak is gone with it.

src/clipboard.c:clip_wl_receive_data.note: In 9.2.0015: tmp = string_convert(); final = tmp; clip_yank_selection() copies; tmp never freed. At upstream HEAD the conversion moved into clip_convert_data(..., &tofree) followed by vim_free(tofree), so the leak is gone (refactor commit, subject without 'leak').

src/ex_docmd.c:ex_redir.note: fname = expand_env_save(); under FEAT_BROWSE a cancelled dialog returns without vim_free(fname). Unfixed upstream.

src/gui_gtk_x11.c:gui_gtk_draw_string.note: conv_buf = string_convert(); alloc(convlen+2) failure returns without vim_free(conv_buf). Same class as patches 9.2.0773-0803 (alloc-failure leaks). Unfixed upstream.

src/json.c:json_decode_item.note: dictitem freed on dict_add failure, owned by the dict on success.

src/optionstr.c:did_set_pumborder.note: In 9.2.0015: token = vim_strnsave(); the custom: branch has three `goto error` without vim_free(token) (user-triggerable via :set pumborder=custom:bad). Fixed upstream as a side effect of the 9.2.0318 refactor (logic moved to parse_pumopt_border(), which frees token on every failure path); the commit subject does not mention 'leak', so the ground-truth matcher missed it.

src/strings.c:string_reduce.note: fc = eval_expr_get_funccal(); `return` on eval error skips remove_funccal(). Still present at upstream HEAD (9.2.0960 fixed only a double-free here).

src/vim9cmds.c:compile_for.note: scope is linked into cctx->ctx_scope; compile_def_function() drops all scopes on failure.

src/viminfo.c:barline_parse.note: buf = alloc(len+1); `return TRUE; // syntax error` happens before value->bv_tofree = buf, leaking buf on a malformed viminfo file. Still present at upstream HEAD.

src/edit.c:ins_tab.note: WITHDRAWN 2026-09-08 after empirical re-check at upstream 5d934b1b. The alloc() whose failure was said to leak saved_line sits inside `if (!(State & VREPLACE_FLAG))`, while saved_line is only assigned inside `if (State & VREPLACE_FLAG)`; the two are mutually exclusive, so saved_line is always NULL at that return. Deterministic allocation-failure injection at that site produces no leak record.

src/filepath.c:findfilendir.note: each fresult is freed at the start of the next iteration; loop ends only when fresult == NULL.

src/ops.c:do_join.note: ml_replace_len(..., copy=FALSE) takes ownership of newp.

src/option.c:ExpandSettings.note: In 9.2.0015: fuzmatch = ALLOC_MULT() is passed to fuzzymatches_to_strmatches(), which returned FAIL on alloc failure without freeing it. At upstream HEAD that failure path calls fuzmatch_str_free(fuzmatch, count) first, so the leak is gone (commit subject without 'leak').

src/vim9class.c:ex_class.note: cl = ALLOC_CLEAR_ONE(class_T); class_name allocation failure -> goto cleanup, and cleanup never frees cl. Unfixed upstream.

src/match.c:f_setmatches.note: s = list_alloc(); a posN entry that is not a list hits `return;` inside the loop without list_free(s). User-triggerable via setmatches().

src/if_xcmdsrv.c:serverRegisterName.note: p = alloc() inside a do-while; a registration failure on a later iteration returns FAIL without vim_free(p).

src/json.c:json_encode_lsp_msg.note: On failure json_encode_gap() clears the growarray and replaces its data with an allocated empty string (json.c:33-34); json_encode_lsp_msg() then returns NULL without clearing ga, so that string leaks. json_encode() returns ga.ga_data on the same path, so only the LSP variant leaks. Triggered from Vim script via ch_sendexpr() on an LSP-mode channel with a Funcref in the message. Verified with LeakSanitizer (results/upstream-prs/json_lsp_asan.txt); patch drafted.

src/vim9compile.c:reserve_local.note: When GA_GROW_FAILS(&dfunc->df_var_names) the lvar with lv_name already sits in cctx->ctx_locals (ga_len incremented), so lv_name is released with the locals; OOM-only path anyway.

src/vim9execute.c:exec_unpack_tuple.note: list_alloc_with_items() returns a list with lv_refcount 0; the ++lv_refcount after storing it in the stack typval is the single owning reference. Not a leak.

src/beval.c:general_beval_cb.note: get_beval_info(getword=TRUE) returns an allocated `text`; when the buffer has no 'balloonexpr' (*bexpr == NUL) the function falls through without freeing it. Upstream master now has `vim_free(text)` on that path (beval.c:339).

src/evalvars.c:set_internal_string_var.note: alloc_string_tv() frees its argument itself when alloc_tv() fails (typval.c:44-45).

src/ex_docmd.c:expand_sfile.note: Artifact of the unanchored/official-validated model: eval_vars() modelled as a never-NULL allocator, but on the errormsg path it returns NULL; errormsg itself is a static string.

src/vim9generics.c:parse_generic_func_ty.note: When alloc() for gt_name fails the function returns without vim_free(ret_free), the composite type name returned by type_name(); the neighbouring ga_grow() failure path does free it. Needs a composite type argument (for <number> type_name() returns a static string). Verified with LeakSanitizer plus a forced allocation failure (results/upstream-prs/generics_asan.txt); patch drafted.

src/change.c:f_listener_add.note: get_callback() returns cb_name == NULL only on its FAIL path, which is taken before anything is allocated (evalvars.c:5231-5256); the early return on a NULL name therefore frees nothing that was allocated. The empty-name case is a static literal. Reported only in the compile-DB control run, absent in the F and patched-Infer runs: run-to-run noise.

src/option.c:option_set_callback_func.note: get_callback() returns cb_name == NULL only on its FAIL path, which is taken before anything is allocated (evalvars.c:5231-5256); the early return on a NULL name therefore frees nothing that was allocated. The empty-name case is a static literal. Reported only in the compile-DB control run, absent in the F and patched-Infer runs: run-to-run noise.
